title: An Act to Allow Veterans' Organizations and Fraternal Organizations to Obtain a License to Operate the Draw Game Keno

summary.text: This bill authorizes the Director of Alcoholic Beverages and Lottery Operations to issue licenses to nonprofit fraternal or veterans' organizations to conduct a draw game, commonly known as keno, that has more than 5 daily drawings and that pays a player a set prize amount based on the wager made by the player and in which the operator keeps all losing wagers from that organization's physical premises. The bill directs the State Liquor and Lottery Commission to develop and initiate a game of keno designed to raise funds for a charitable purpose for a licensed nonprofit fraternal or veterans' organization and, to the extent possible, develop such rules in a manner consistent with the existing rules for the conduct of other licensed draw games.
